# Inbox

The person does these in the Whatsable app. Give the path and the steps; never say you did it. Fetch the "Full steps" address for the exact steps, or give the person the link.

## Reply to a specific message (quote it)

- **What it is:** Reply to one specific message, quoted above the reply.
- **Plan:** Work, Growth, Pro, Agency and the 14-day trial.
- **Who can do it:** Anyone who can reply in the conversation.
- **Where:** Inbox > right-click the message > Reply
- **The agent can:** read the conversation with `read_conversation`; the quote itself is made in the app
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/features/inbox-conversations.md, section "reply". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/inbox-conversations#reply

## Search inside one conversation

- **What it is:** Search the whole history of one conversation, not only the loaded messages.
- **Plan:** Work, Growth, Pro, Agency and the 14-day trial.
- **Who can do it:** Anyone who can open the conversation.
- **Where:** Inbox > open the conversation > the search button in its header
- **The agent can:** read the messages with `list_messages` and search them yourself
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/features/inbox-conversations.md, section "search-in-a-conversation". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/inbox-conversations#search-in-a-conversation

## Edited and deleted messages

- **What it is:** A message the customer edited shows Edited, with its earlier versions.
- **Plan:** Work, Growth, Pro, Agency and the 14-day trial. The inbox cannot edit or delete a sent message.
- **Who can do it:** Anyone who can open the conversation.
- **Where:** Inbox > Edited
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/features/inbox-conversations.md, section "edited-messages". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/inbox-conversations#edited-messages

## Chats that started from an ad

- **What it is:** A chat that started from a Facebook or Instagram ad shows an Ad badge and the ad on its first message.
- **Plan:** Work, Growth, Pro, Agency and the 14-day trial.
- **Who can do it:** Anyone who can open the conversation.
- **Where:** Inbox > the Ad badge > View ad
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/features/inbox-conversations.md, section "the-thread". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/inbox-conversations#the-thread

## React to a message

- **What it is:** React to a customer's message with an emoji.
- **Plan:** Work, Growth, Pro, Agency and the 14-day trial.
- **Who can do it:** Anyone who can reply in the conversation.
- **Where:** Inbox > React
- **The agent can:** react with `react_to_message`
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/features/inbox-conversations.md, section "reactions". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/inbox-conversations#reactions

## Export conversations

- **What it is:** Download the current inbox view, or every conversation, as a CSV file.
- **Plan:** Work, Growth, Pro, Agency and the 14-day trial.
- **Who can do it:** Owners and admins.
- **Where:** Inbox > the download button above the list
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/features/inbox-conversations.md, section "export-conversations". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/inbox-conversations#export-conversations

## Export every contact

- **What it is:** Download every contact, with labels, notes and dates, as a CSV file.
- **Plan:** Bulk Message, Work, Growth, Pro and Agency.
- **Who can do it:** Owners and admins. Members do not see it.
- **Where:** Settings > Organization > Contact export > Export contacts
- **The agent can:** page through contacts with `find_contacts`
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/features/contact-export.md, section "download-the-file". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/contact-export#download-the-file

## Route chats without an assignee

- **What it is:** There is no assignee: chats reach the right people through labels and each member's number and label access.
- **Plan:** Work, Growth, Pro, Agency and the 14-day trial.
- **Who can do it:** Owners and admins set member access. Anyone labels a contact.
- **Where:** Team > Edit access
- **The agent can:** label the contact with `add_contact_label`, so the members limited to that label see the chat
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/features/chat-assignment.md, section "step-1-give-each-member-the-right-access". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/chat-assignment#step-1-give-each-member-the-right-access

## Instagram and Messenger conversations

- **What it is:** Instagram and Messenger chats sit in the same inbox as WhatsApp.
- **Plan:** Work, Growth, Pro, Agency and the 14-day trial. The MCP tools reach WhatsApp only, so these chats are read and answered in the inbox.
- **Who can do it:** Anyone who can open the conversation.
- **Where:** Inbox
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/features/inbox-conversations.md. For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/inbox-conversations
